column1: Traffic reports will resume on Tuesday, Aug. 12 at 4 p.m.

column3: TRAFFIC ALERT FOR N. BROADWAY AT I-75S:
column4: The on-ramp from N. Broadway to I-75S is shut down until further notice due to a semi on its side.  A large fuel spill has also been reported.

column3: TRAFFIC ALERT FOR N. BROADWAY AT I-75S:
column4: Motorists may access I-75S via Newtown Pike or Winchester Road, or use I-75N from N. Broadway toward Newtown Pike, then back on I-75S.
